summary: TEMA Middleware Phase 3.3 (technicians business API) independently verified. Build+lint clean, 96 unit tests pass, 50 e2e tests pass across 7 suites. OpenAPI contains exactly the 6 required paths [/api/technicians,/health,/health/integrations,/me,/ready,/version] with bearer security and 200/401/403/503 documented on GET /api/technicians. Runtime boot on TEMA_PORT=8140 confirms /health UP, /ready READY, /version, /health/integrations (sql-server & sage-x3 DISABLED), unknown route -> NOT_FOUND with requestId, and GET /api/technicians without token returns 401 AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED (fail-closed). Correlation id echoed via x-correlation-id header. E2E suite verifies auth (401), forbidden without technician.read (403), 200 with data + count, empty source -> 200 count:0, SQL timeout -> 504 TIMEOUT_ERROR with no leakage of stored-proc name ('usp_test_get_technicians'), credentials ('p@ss', 'db-internal'), or stack, and SQL connection failure -> 502. Service goes through SqlServerAdapter.executeStoredProcedure + TransactionTrackerService (no direct DB in controller).
critical_code_review_comments: Config-driven stored proc (SQL_TECHNICIANS_PROCEDURE) is a good abstraction; returns 503 INTEGRATION_NOT_CONFIGURED when unset, which is by design until real schema is provided.
SQL error mapping properly strips internalDetails from client responses; verified via e2e negative assertions.
Consider adding a positive assertion in e2e that the response body contains 'code' and 'requestId' shape for 502 as well (currently only 504 body shape asserted explicitly).
test_credentials: Dev HS256 tokens minted inline in e2e spec; no external credentials needed.
seed_data_creation: None; SqlServerAdapter is overridden with a mock inside the e2e suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3.3 stable. yarn build/lint/test/test:e2e/openapi:generate all green. Manual boot on 8140 confirmed. Kill background node with `pkill -f dist/main.js`.
